Board supplies SIX poses in two rows: three with a RED 'JOB FAIL' screen and three with a GREEN one, the last of which is tipped over (deactivated). MVP selects 4: green neutral, green walk A, green walk B, tipped-over deactivated. The red-screen trio is recorded as SKIPPED, not discarded -- it is the natural artwork for an 'alerted' visual state in a later pass.
all four source poses

Four poses. WARNING: one baked screen reads 'SPDOOL RUNAWAY' (typo in the source art). The MVP keeps baked screen text, so that frame would ship the typo. Prefer the three correctly-spelled poses plus the tape-symbol screen pose; otherwise clean that screen interior.

Four poses with a spinning top rotor and twin thruster flames. Rotor width VARIES per frame, which is exactly why common-centre alignment is mandatory: bbox-based alignment would make the drone wobble in flight.

Board supplies three round '>_' coin views plus one thin vertical bar (the edge-on view). Rotation order must be front, angled, EDGE (the bar), angled -- reading order alone will not produce a smooth spin, so the reorder hook in crops.json is required here.

Gold chevron badge with a dashed halo in cyan, magenta, lime and white -- the four pulse accents the handoff requires, confirmed present. Note the badge reuses the operational icon chevron, tying the pickup visually to the icon blocks.

PLAYBACK CHANGED IN v3. The source rings already ramp small -> large -> small, i.e. a complete symmetric pulse is baked into the frames. Ping-pong playback would therefore replay the shrink and stutter. Straight loop is correct. OPEN QUESTION: the board visually reads as 7 OR 8 rings. Contract holds 7; if assets:inspect reports 8, change exactly two values -- frame_count here and INVINCIBILITY.AURA_FRAME_COUNT in src/config/Tuning.ts. Animations.ts derives its sequence from that constant, and tests/unit/contract.test.ts enforces the two agree.
